projects.name: Sureal Number Calculator
projects.summary: The Surreal number system is an extension of the Real number system which includes every real number (e.g, π, √2, e, etc…), as well as more “exotic” numbers, such as ω (which is in some sense the “first” infinite number), ω+1, ω², and other even stranger numbers, such as ω-1, √ω, (1/ ω), π × ω, etc. Using Java, I wrote a calculator which does operations (+, -, ×) on this number system, including a custom parser and numeric comparator. So far as I can tell I am the first to implement this!
